Cinq mots absents des 659 contenus du label (vérifié dans donnees/label.json ; halcyon, ineffable, sanguine et laconic y étaient déjà) : ebullient, reticent, lucid, pensive, autodidact. Images : captures de la série (style @gilmoreobssesed) pour l'accroche, les mots et la fin ; la slide Sophia sur des étagères de livres, sans personne réelle. slides.texte_overlay:
5 words that will
instantly expand
your vocabulary

Ebullient: cheerful and
full of energy
(ih-BUL-yuhnt)

Example:
Her ebullient laugh filled
the whole café.

Reticent: slow to share your
thoughts or feelings
(RET-uh-suhnt)

Example:
She stayed reticent about
her plans.

Lucid: clear and easy to
understand
(LOO-sid)

Example:
Her answer was short and
lucid.

Pensive: lost in deep or
serious thought
(PEN-siv)

Example:
She looked pensive by the
window.

Autodidact: a self-taught
person
(aw-toh-DY-dakt)

Example:
She became an autodidact,
learning something new
every morning.
